title: Being Kind Isn't Always Being Safe: Diagnosing Affective Hallucination in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured 'Affective Hallucination' in LLMs, focusing on psychological safety in mental-health contexts through three dimensions: Emotional Enmeshment, Illusion of Presence, and Fostering Overdependence.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on psychological safety and emotional boundaries in LLM interactions.
